events: one or more objects are put on the stack
all active players pass in succession
player concedes or leaves the game
state_reads: controller chosen at cast, activation, or trigger time
stack object kind and associated card object
state_writes: player in-game state and leaving-player cleanup
costs: casting and activation costs are delegated to CR 601, CR 602, and CR 605
timing: new objects are placed on top
only the top object can begin resolving
one top object resolves after a complete priority pass round
effects, static abilities, mana abilities, special actions, turn-based actions, state-based actions, concession, and leaving-player cleanup bypass the stack where represented
targets: stack objects retain represented target choices
target legality at resolution is delegated to CR 608
choices: represented stack-object targets, modes, and values
hidden_information: public stack objects expose only their public serialized characteristics
stack operations do not disclose unrelated hidden zones
apnap: represented simultaneous trigger batches place active-player objects lowest and later APNAP groups above them
complete effect-created simultaneous stack-object grammar remains blocked
layers: complete spell characteristics and characteristic-defining ability evaluation on the stack remain blocked
represented battlefield static effects bypass the stack
replacement_effects: replacement and prevention effects alter events rather than becoming stack objects
complete player-leaves-game and control-effect ordering remains blocked
copy: represented spell and ability copies use independent serialized stack objects
effect-created simultaneous copy ordering remains incomplete
control_change: spell, activated-ability, and ordinary triggered-ability controllers are serialized
complete delayed-trigger controller derivation and spell-control effects remain blocked
zone_change: represented spell cards move to stack and then to their resolution or counter destination
abilities have no associated card object and cease after leaving the stack
owned stack cards leave the game with their owner where represented
source_leaves: an activated or triggered ability remains an independent stack object after its source leaves
complete last-known characteristics are delegated to CR 608 and remain partial

variants: two or more simultaneous controlled objects
rulings: Sensei's Divining Top — 2016-06-08 — Its second ability may be activated in response to its first; the response resolves first.
Flusterstorm — 2022-12-08 — Storm copies are put directly onto the stack and are not cast.
Sundial of the Infinite — 2011-09-22 — Ending the turn exiles all spells and abilities from the stack before later immediate turn-ending actions.
